verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official help explicitly offers step-by-step tutorials covering both installing Ubuntu Desktop and exploring the user interface (ubuntu-docs-9). The documentation also has a dedicated installation section, including creating a bootable USB, the install guide, and Windows-switcher topics such as BitLocker and Intel RST (ubuntu-docs-34, ubuntu-docs-10, ubuntu-docs-35, ubuntu-docs-22), plus beginner material like the command line for beginners (ubuntu-docs-48). Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the desktop-interface tutorial content (only a one-line mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration that switchers find the tutorials effective.
